verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser has a dedicated docs page stating it can automatically detect and solve CAPTCHAs when enabled at session creation, which is an explicit, documented captcha stance (automatic solving). Stealth and Ultra Stealth modes are documented alongside it. One community report of being blocked by Cloudflare concerns bot detection generally and does not specifically contradict captcha solving. missing for 10: documentation of supported CAPTCHA types and limits, how unsolved captchas are surfaced instead of failing silently, any human-fallback option, independent hands-on corroboration of solving success.
